mechanism: On each bar, seed color by candle direction then grow a running prior high/low envelope; if High[c]<envelope_high and Low[c]>envelope_low mark color index 1 (inside/compression), else reset envelope to DBL_MIN/DBL_MAX. Demo vehicle for dynamic PlotIndexSetInteger DRAW_COLOR_CANDLES/BARS, but the buffer logic is an explicit range-compression regime flag.

mechanism: Merge FRED DTWEXBGS (Nominal Broad Dollar), DGS10, T5YIFR with EURUSD D1 OHLC+tick_volume; transform predictors with pct_change(periods=365)*100; observe ~−0.9 corr of Broad Dollar YoY vs EURUSD and ~−0.7 vs close shifted −20 days. Ablate OHLC-only vs FRED-only vs ALL through identical MLPRegressor CV; forward selection kept only open/high/low—FRED series unused by the model despite strong pairwise corr.
data_needed: fredapi series DTWEXBGS/DGS10/T5YIFR; MT5 EURUSD D1 OHLC+tick_volume; look_ahead=20; 365-day pct change.

mechanism: After fitting the tuned MLP on train, compute residuals = test_y − predict(test_X), plot the residual path, and run statsmodels plot_acf(residuals, lags=40). Autocorrelated, non-flat residuals are treated as evidence the sensor/model has not learned the target cleanly and may need further transforms.
data_needed: Hold-out test residuals from the EURUSD+FRED regressor; ACF lags≤40.
why_new_for_mis: Provides MIS a residual-ACF health gate for any forecasting sensor—reject or down-weight when residuals remain serially correlated.
quote: Measuring auto-correlation is a robust approach to detecting possible spurious regressions. Unfortunately, our model residuals failed this test too

mechanism: VAM = (close − close[momentum_period]) / (volatility × √momentum_period) × 10000, with volatility from SMA(close, volatility_period) in the first EA and iStdDev in the ONNX EA. Sign is direction; magnitude is momentum strength scaled by recent volatility so calm vs stormy regimes are comparable. Trade when |VAM| > VAMTHRESH; ATR×slmul/tpmul sets stops.
data_needed: Close series; momentum_period, volatility_period, vam_period, VAMTHRESH; ATR(14).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart Symbol/_Period (backtests after 2024-01-01 for ONNX path); ATR on PERIOD_CURRENT
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a simple volatility-normalized momentum scalar that equalizes signal strength across calm and high-vol regimes.

mechanism: ONNX Conditional LSTM: sequence input_x[1,30,3] = min–max normalized close + MACD main + MACD signal over SEQUENCE_LENGTH; condition input = current MACD main/signal; h0/c0 zeroed. Prediction class from Δ of successive denormalized forecasts (UP/SAME/DOWN). Entry only if VAM>VAMTHRESH and class==PRICE_UP (buy) or VAM<−VAMTHRESH and class==PRICE_DOWN (sell)—momentum regime gates the sequence forecast.
data_needed: 30-bar close+MACD(12,26,9); daily ExtMin/ExtMax for norm; stock_prediction_model_MACD.onnx; VAM inputs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Symbol/_Period with embedded ONNX; MACD on PERIOD_CURRENT; Colab-trained MACD model
why_new_for_mis: Combines a MACD-conditioned LSTM direction class with a VAM magnitude gate—MIS can reuse the dual-input sequence+condition pattern as a hybrid neural/vol sensor.
quote: if(vam > VAMTHRESH && result == 0) { trade.Buy(...); } else if(vam < -VAMTHRESH && result == 2) { trade.Sell(...); }

mechanism: Grid look_ahead∈[2,100] step 4 and differencing period∈[2,100] step 4; clean_data diffs OHLC by period and targets Close.shift(−look_ahead); score LinearRegression and MLPRegressor under TimeSeriesSplit; contour/surface of |CV error| picks the white-dot optimum (article finds ~20–40 band for linear GBPUSD Daily). Classical 1-step/1-day returns are not assumed optimal.
data_needed: GBPUSD Daily OHLC CSV; meshgrid of look_ahead×period; TimeSeriesSplit with gap=look_ahead.
why_new_for_mis: Treats (forecast horizon, returns period) as a searchable sensing geometry—MIS can pick the error-minimizing transform before fitting any model.
quote: our simple linear AI model would have easily outperformed any trader in the market that was using the classical return period of 1 and forecasting 1 step into the future.

mechanism: Fix small MLP (6,5); train with max_iter=2^j for j=0..49; record Train/Validation/Test MSE under TimeSeriesSplit. Observe classical rise then second descent; best test error near 2^30 iterations—far past early-stopping/default 200. Then RandomizedSearchCV with that max_iter, export ONNX, and gate entries with BB mid + high/low MA channel agreement vs forecast.
data_needed: Differenced OHLC + target at chosen horizon; err_rates over epoch indices; ONNX FloatTensorType[1,4].
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD Daily; EA on PERIOD_D1 with iBands(60) and iMA(14) on high/low
why_new_for_mis: Reframes training-iteration count as a tunable neural-sensor hyperparameter via double descent, instead of treating long training as pure overfit.
quote: Our optimal error rates were produced when our model was allowed to perform more than 1 billion iterations! The exact number is 2 to the power 30.

mechanism: Fetch the same N=400 bars on MN1,W1,D1,H12,H8,H4,H1,M30,M15,M5,M1 for EURUSD; target = close 20 steps ahead on each TF; fit LinearRegression per TF with 50/50 chronological split and 5-fold CV; rank TFs by residual/error barplot. Lowest error on Monthly and Hourly—counter to ‘further ahead is harder’ intuition (20 MN steps ≈ 20 months).
data_needed: 400 closes per TF from MT5; look_ahead=20; per-TF train/test splits shuffle=False.
why_new_for_mis: Defines optimal timeframe as the one minimizing forecast residual under equal sample size—MIS can rank TFs as a meta-sensor before feature build.

mechanism: On pct_change returns, grangercausalitytests(H1→MN) significant at lag 1 (p≈0.035) while MN→H1 fails all lags—supports modeling monthly returns from hourly returns (VAR). dtaidistance DTW warping_path aligns MN vs H1 return series to locate shared motifs. EA predicts on PERIOD_MN1 ONNX and times entries on D1 BB breakout + RSI + MA side.
data_needed: Aligned MN and H1 close pct_change; statsmodels Granger maxlag=4; DTW path; MN1 ONNX close→target.
